After each action is performed by the telephony provider, the provider’s delegate calls either the [`fulfill()`](cxaction/fulfill().md) method, indicating that the action was successfully performed, or the [`fail()`](cxaction/fail().md) method, to indicate that an error occurred; both of these methods set the [`isComplete`](cxaction/iscomplete.md) property of the action to [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true).
